# Awwwards

> > Awwwards recognizes and promotes the talent and effort of the best web designers, developers and agencies in the world.

Awwwards is a global digital design community and awards platform that evaluates and showcases outstanding website designs across categories like business, corporate, and experimental web experiences. The platform hosts international conferences in cities including New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, Paris, and Berlin, bringing together digital thinkers and industry leaders.

## Key Topics

- Web Design Awards
- Digital Design Community
- Web Development Recognition
- Design Inspiration
- Developer Award
- Jury Evaluation System
- Brand Identity
- Professional Design
- Awwwards Conference
- Business Websites
- Corporate Websites
- Website Showcase
- New York
- San Francisco
- Tokyo
